InputMap.bindings:
move_x = d, a:-1, gamepad.lx, arrowright, arrowleft:-1
move_y = w, s:-1, gamepad.ly, arrowup, arrowdown:-1
look_x = gamepad.rx
look_y = gamepad.ry
attack = mouse_left, j, gamepad.x, gamepad.rt
roll = mouse_right, q, gamepad.b, gamepad.lt
jump = space, gamepad.a
sprint = shift, gamepad.ls, gamepad.lb
interact = e, gamepad.y
quest = l, gamepad.back
pause = escape, gamepad.start
dialogue_next = enter, space, gamepad.a
dialogue_choice_1 = 1
dialogue_choice_2 = 2, gamepad.b
dialogue_choice_3 = 3, gamepad.x
dialogue_choice_4 = 4, gamepad.y
ui_up = w, arrowup, gamepad.dpad_up
ui_down = s, arrowdown, gamepad.dpad_down
ui_left = a, arrowleft, gamepad.dpad_left
ui_right = d, arrowright, gamepad.dpad_right
ui_accept = enter, gamepad.a
deadzone = 0.15

TerrainLayers.layers:
grass grass uv_scale=340 bump=0.02
rock dirt uv_scale=260 tint=0.8,0.76,0.72 bump=0.06
sand sand uv_scale=340 bump=0.01
ash examples/caldera/world/ash.png uv_scale=180

SceneReset.resources: paused leave fire time.scale cutscene talking settings questlog dead dead.t hitstop swing dmg shake flash fxgo splash prompt toast toast.k toast.t tgt tgt.d wraith.next wraith.timer lit.t boss.mode kills g.*

systems.name: scene_init
systems.doc: The first tick of a scene.

systems.name: fader
systems.doc: Anything that wants to leave sets `$leave` to the number of a switch; the picture fades to black, then the switch is thrown.

systems.name: settings_buttons
systems.doc: The settings: the mouse, the volumes, the language (a click on the button cycles through `LanguageList`).

systems.name: music_select
systems.doc: The tracks are one `MusicPlayer` each (in the boot scene, `Persist`); the scene says which should play with `$music`: 1 the title, 2 day, 3 night, 4 the boss.
